summary: Full-colour Marathi/English classifieds: spaced light CLASSIFIEDS caps with jigsaw-piece letters, a red booking banner, a top row of named feature boxes (Property of the Day, Pick of the Day, Top Vacancies, Health of the Day, Business Corner), a HOT PROPERTY panel of yellow listing boxes, then narrow liners with tick and paperclip markers.

frame.masthead: Paper logo over CLA**SS**IFIEDS in wide-spaced light sans with two letters as red/blue jigsaw pieces; a full-width red banner with Marathi booking line, hand-cursor icon and URL pill.

headers.notes: Each feature box has a named header with a small icon (tick, heart-pulse, briefcase) and a red or blue outline.
Map-pin icon in a red circle, heavy caps; locality sub-labels as red bars with pin glyphs.
Muted teal label bars for Marathi classifications, some with small line icons.

units.example: FLAT FOR SALE AT GREENFIELD-2 / 2 BHK @ RS. 22 LACS Onwards
units.notes: Pale yellow fill, red heavy head, blue body caps, phone numbers in red bold, booking code turned sideways at the edge.

units.example: ✓ Require Service Engineer for Medical Equipment...
units.notes: Red tick or paperclip glyph to flag a premium liner; booking code in parentheses.

type.look: Heavy Arial Black-like caps in red and blue
Devanagari text face with Latin sans for English ads

notes: Named daily feature boxes (Pick of the Day etc.) are a strong generator hook for a page's top row.
